build_community_catalog: build the TFDS community dataset catalog documentation from GCS index and save to a catalog directory
build_overview_page: build the overview markdown page with table of contents for all community dataset namespaces
build_toc_yaml: build the _toc.yaml navigation file for TFDS community catalog documentation site
build_namespace_details: build markdown detail pages for all datasets within each community dataset namespace
build_dataset_details: build individual markdown detail pages for each dataset within a namespace
